card.name: Colonial-era Asian history and places
card.fires_on: Small words like in, from, the, or a comma in passages on colonial history or places in South and Southeast Asia, such as Ooty, Penang, Maluku and Taiwan. It fires on the word just before a place, ruler or date is named.

modes.label: Linking word before a place or date
modes.description: A small word such as in, from or the sits right before a colonial-era place, people or year.
modes.example: Penang was acquired by the English government by cession<< from>> a native prince in 178

modes.label: Inside place names
modes.description: Partway through an Indian place or term name.

card.writes: It pushes toward Taiwanese and Chinese place names such as 台北 and 台湾, and away from Cyrillic and Turkish-type tokens.
card.plain: It marks small words in passages about colonial history in Asia, just before a place or date comes up.
